title: Directional transport for characteristic symbols

mathematical_sources.title: Lars Hörmander, The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators IV
mathematical_sources.edition: Corrected second printing 1994, approved 2009 eBook ISBN 978-3-642-00136-9
mathematical_sources.full_section_read: Signed relations, Theorem 26.1.14 and its entire proof, complete Lemmas 26.1.15 and 26.1.16 and the following signed-component extension

changes: Preserve all seventeen original obligations, fourteen displays, three full solutions and the original exact source-boundary SVG.
Reconnect complete global flow, flat Maslov line, density, transport, wavefront and all-real Sobolev providers.
Supply actual three-stage contraction, finite compact-square mesh and frame-transport cancellation, with compatible dilation.
Make the overlap Jacobian, moving lower endpoint, fixed interpolation formula and continuity in every symbol seminorm explicit.
Prove frame independence and uniform conic neighborhoods for microsupport decay, including ambient closure of the reflexive hull.
Supply exact smooth-coefficient conormal wavefront at flat boundaries, explicit bumps and agreement of Fourier Sobolev extensions with actual distributions.
